pages.text: The Body Scanner is a $(bold)pure display panel$() - no materials or energy required.$(br)Right-click to open the examination screen and view the $(bold)examiner's own$() body state - organ/limb implants and rejection across 9 slots.

The human body has $(bold)9 body slots$(): 5 organs (eye, heart, lungs, viscera, kidneys) + 4 limbs (left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg).$(br2)Implanting requires an empty slot; extracting a part deals $(bold)armor-piercing$() damage (Creative players are exempt).$(br2)Life weights: the heart slot counts 20%, the rest 10% each - empty slots reduce max health accordingly.

Each part has a rejection value of $(bold)0-100$(); the higher, the more dangerous.$(br2)Implanting poorly-matched organs accumulates rejection and triggers the part's debuff (blindness, weakness, poison, mining fatigue...).$(br2)$(2)Check regularly and remove runaway parts in time.$()
